title: A week of every train in Philadelphia
description:
A week of every train in Philadelphia, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Philadelphia city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Regional Rail, B and L, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 63 trains, Thursday at 5:35 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night. SEPTA Regional Rail changed its timetables during October, so its Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date.
